item.title: MAPPED: Where gas prices are rising the fastest from the Iran conflict
item.summary: Gasoline, diesel and jet fuel prices have jumped as the conflict between the U.S., Israel and Iran squeezes oil shipments through the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: Iran responds to reports US weighing ground operations: 'We will never accept humiliation'
item.summary: Iran's parliament speaker vows never to accept "humiliation" as the Pentagon reportedly prepares ground force options near the Strait of Hormuz for Trump.

item.title: Cases of 'white plague' rising in US as doctors warn of 'rebound effect'
item.summary: Tuberculosis, also known as "the white plague," is rising in the U.S. post-pandemic, with over 10,600 cases confirmed in 2024, the CDC reports.

item.title: North Korea tests solid-fuel missile engine as Kim boosts threat to US mainland
item.summary: Kim Jong Un oversaw a new solid-fuel rocket engine test, state media reports, as North Korea pushes to upgrade its long-range strategic strike capabilities.

item.title: Are robots coming to a McDonald’s near you?
item.summary: McDonald's tested humanoid robots from Keenon Robotics at a Shanghai location, where they greeted customers and delivered food in a short pilot program.

item.title: DHS shutdown putting Americans at risk as World Cup security prep ‘significantly behind’: Sen Fetterman
item.summary: Sen. John Fetterman urges an end to the weeks-long DHS shutdown, warning that TSA staffing losses threaten airport security ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup.

item.title: 'Burn Notice' star ditched Los Angeles for Colorado after meeting his wife and says he's 'never leaving'
item.summary: "Burn Notice" star Jeffrey Donovan says Colorado is the true sunshine state as he raises his three kids there and has no plans to ever leave.

item.title: Republicans can fund ICE for an entire decade without a single Dem vote: Sen Cruz
item.summary: Sen. Ted Cruz says Republicans can fund ICE for a decade using reconciliation, bypassing Democrats who he claims will never again vote to fund the agency.

item.title: Executed killer’s chilling claim about what she felt during pickax murders still haunts retired FBI agent
item.summary: Retired FBI profiler Candice DeLong says Karla Faye Tucker's troubled childhood and drug use doomed her long before the 1983 pickax murders that sent her to death row.

item.title: Catholic conversions rise as young adults 'hungry for truth' turn to faith and reject secularism, bishop says
item.summary: Catholic dioceses across the U.S. are reporting record adult converts, with Bishop Robert Barron saying young adults are leading a return to faith.
